div.div: phc2sys HA profile (haProfiles: bc1, bc2): when BC1's slave link (L1) fails, phc2sys switches to BC2's PHC as OS-clock source and BC2's PHC also disciplines BC1's PHC

link (L1) fails, phc2sys switches to BC2's PHC as OS-clock
source and BC2's PHC also disciplines BC1's PHC

div.div:
PtpConfigs
• test-grandmaster — worker2, ens3f0 + ens3f1
• test-bc-master1 — worker nic1 (ptp4l only)
• test-bc-master2 — worker nic2 (ptp4l only)
• HA profile — phc2sys only, haProfiles = bc1, bc2 profiles
• test-slave1 / test-slave2 — worker3
When BC1's slave link (L1) fails, phc2sys switches to BC2's PHC as the OS-clock source, and BC2's PHC also disciplines BC1's PHC while its slave interface is down.

text.tspan: • HA profile — phc2sys only, haProfiles = bc1, bc2 profiles
When BC1's slave link (L1) fails, phc2sys switches to BC2's
PHC as the OS-clock source, and BC2's PHC also disciplines
BC1's PHC while its slave interface is down.
